desc.desc: Deal Physical damage to 1 foe equal to 42.5% of Attack (2 to 3 hits).
Deal Psy damage to all foes equal to 54.4% of Attack. Deal a Technical and increase damage by 40% for foes with a spiritual ailment.
Increase party's Attack by 8.2%. For every 500 of the user's Attack, increase party's Attack by 0.7% more, up to 5.4%. Lasts for 3 turns.

tutorial.title: Unique Shadow Abilities
tutorial.content:
1. At the start of battle, Okuninushi cannot be targeted by attacks. Also, <color=#FF423F>Ara Mitama</color> and <color=#FF423F>Nigi Mitama</color> summoned by Okuninushi are in the Soul Link state.
2. Each turn, Okuninushi selects 1 Shadow. The selected Shadow's final damage taken is greatly increased. Other Shadows' final damage taken is greatly decreased, and when they take damage, Okuninushi gains 1 Mitama's Rage stack. Attacking the selected Shadow is recommended.
Mitama's Rage: Increase final damage dealt.
3. Each turn, Okuninushi's damage dealt is increased. When all summoned Shadows are defeated, Okuninushi enters the Mitama's Tranquility state, making it targetable for 2 turns. After this state ends, Okuninushi will once again become untargetable by attacks, and summons Shadows again.
Mitama's Tranquility: Become targetable, and increase final damage taken.
